attacksRun.attack: claims gates 2 and 3 do not hold (this is a gate row)
attacksRun.detail: Checked with particular care because this lineage inverts the sibling pattern. D-150 through D-153 each state 'Gates 2 and 3 do not hold for DR-131', but D-154 — the act that completed the NT coverage — states 'After this act, D-056 Eligibility gates 2 and 3 hold for DR-131's eight NT classes.' The subject makes NO gate-2 or gate-3 assertion in either direction; the strings do not occur, nor does 'eligib'. That silence is doubly correct: asserting the gates do not hold would now contradict adopted D-154, and asserting they do hold would edge a leftover-join into an eligibility claim it has no authority to make. The subject's proposedLaterWork respects gate 4's reservation by conditioning any DR-131 test on 'when D-056 five gates hold' without asserting the current standing of any of them.

Two occurrences, both negations: authorityClaim's 'It applies nothing and does not authorize docs/v2/implementation/' and the doesNot entry. proposedLaterWork proposes only later D-000 recording, later fixture authoring with independent pinning, and a later SATISFIED-GRADE cycle, each disclaimed as not performed here.

attacksRun.attack: the corpus is asymmetric — all three live evidence cells are NT-8, so NT-7 has no evidence member and the subject's pairing of NT-7 with NT-8 overstates NT-7's coverage
attacksRun.detail: Raised as a candidate blocker after finding EV-1, EV-2 and EV-3 all declare suppliedBy 'NT-8. Not authored.' The harness handles the asymmetry explicitly rather than hiding it. It carries a fourth entry, EV-4, suppliedBy 'NT-7. Not authored.', marked notALiveEvidenceCellMember true, with claimLimbVerbatim 'Host must not mint fail/warn other than core policyOutcome' and the reason 'The live three-member evidence cell is entirely NT-8. NT-7 is the claim's first limb and is retained here as a claim limb, not as a fourth live-cell member.' That is exactly right against the register: the live evidence cell has three clauses, all NT-8, while NT-7 lives in the live CLAIM cell's first limb. The subject preserves this correctly — OBL-G28-EXECUTION renders both limbs, 'host-must-not-mint of fail/warn other than core policyOutcome AND of D9 class/exit/HostTermination from pack threshold or policyOutcome', in the register's own order, so NT-7 is carried through the claim rather than falsely attributed to the evidence cell. The subject never enumerates evidence-cell membership, so it cannot and does not misstate which cells belong to which NT.

attacksRun.attack: the harness is cited as v3 while this artifact is also v3, and unlike every other cross-artifact citation in the document the harness entry carries no 'Not this artifact's version number' guard
attacksRun.detail: Raised as a candidate SHOULD-FIX because this is the first join in the wave where a cited artifact's version number collides numerically with the join's own, and the guard exists precisely for version-number hygiene. The convention was surveyed across g25, g26, g27 and g28 leftover-join v3: in all four the guard is applied to join-lineage predecessors and to cross-lineage joins, and in all four it is absent from the harness entry. The absence here is therefore uniform practice, not an omission, and three independent mechanisms disambiguate anyway — the fully qualified path, the harness-only field names the reasons cite (liveHarnessCellVerbatim, which exists in no join), and the role's own sentence 'This artifact is the leftover-join of leftover-design of that specification', which separates the two artifacts explicitly. g28-leftover-join.v2 already cited the harness at v3 under the same key, so no pin drifted.

attacksRun.attack: the harness-spec obligation quietly records or qualifies the specification
attacksRun.detail: OBL-G28-HARNESS-SPEC marks leftoverDesign false on the narrow ground that the specification now exists, then bounds itself: 'CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED; not QUALIFIED', 'Recording remains a later D-000 act', 'This join does not record that specification and does not execute G28'. The specification exists at the pinned digest, which recomputes, and its single-reviewer standing is disclosed. rideStanding stays 'qualification-at-named-gate' rather than claiming discharge.

attacksRun.attack: basedOn.d154 attributes to D-154 a phrase that decision never states — 'Host maps only existing D9 v1.14 classes' appears nowhere in its prose
attacksRun.detail: The textual gap is real: D-154's prose says 'Invents no D9 code' but never 'Host maps only existing D9 v1.14 classes', which occurs once in file 08's DR-G28 evidence cell. Provenance defeats the finding. D-154's Decision states 'File 08 gains the G28 row', and a grep of the whole of COORD confirms D-154 is the ONLY decision that has ever touched DR-G28 — no later entry edited that row. The live evidence cell therefore exists solely by D-154's act. The basedOn role field describes what a cited decision established rather than what its prose quotes, which is how the sibling joins use it. The phrase is verifiable against live bytes and expands nothing.

attacksRun.attack: the input-corpus obligation is used to discharge fixture authoring
attacksRun.detail: OBL-G28-INPUT-CORPUS closes only the initial-state NAMING claim and ends 'This join does not close OBL-G28-FX-AUTHORING and does not invent a D9 code.' The corpus it consumes is CANDIDATE-NOT-APPLIED, binds NOTHING, and carries NOT-AUTHORED markers on its named states, so the naming layer supplies no bytes. doesNotCloseLeftoverAlone states the split explicitly.

attacksRun.attack: the obligation partition is malformed, hiding an obligation from the summary
attacksRun.detail: The union of summary.leftoverDesign, specifiedNotLeftover and qualificationAtNamedGate is exactly the six-member obligation id set, with no duplicate and no orphan, and every per-obligation boolean agrees with its placement.

attacksRun.detail: The clause reads 'This join does not unwrite D-154 or D-167 through D-202', extending the span through the newly adopted D-202 and separately preserving D-154, the decision that named this gate and closed the NT-7/NT-8 remainders. The COORD pin is the post-D-202 digest and the last live heading is D-202, so the span and the pin agree with each other and with live state.

observationsNotFindings: D-154 is the point in the DR-131 sequence where D-056 eligibility gates 2 and 3 flip from 'do not hold' to 'hold', because it completed the eight-class NT coverage. Every earlier gate-naming decision in this run states the negative. The subject is silent on the question, which is correct for a leftover-join, but it means a reader tracing gate standing across D-150 through D-154 must read those decisions rather than this artifact.

The live evidence cell for DR-G28 is entirely NT-8; NT-7 is carried in the live claim cell's first limb. The harness makes this explicit with a fourth, non-live-cell entry flagged notALiveEvidenceCellMember. The subject preserves the asymmetry by rendering both claim limbs and never enumerating evidence-cell membership. This is the only gate in the run where the two owned NT classes sit in different register cells.

This is the first join in the wave whose cited harness carries the same version number as the join itself, both v3. No 'Not this artifact's version number' guard is applied to the harness entry, but that is uniform across g25 through g28, and the path, the harness-only field names and the role's own separating sentence disambiguate.

decision: ACCEPT — 0 blockers, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Seventeen attacks run, all refuted against live bytes, including two candidate findings raised and defeated: an NT-7 coverage challenge killed by the harness's explicit non-live-cell EV-4 and by the subject rendering both claim limbs, and a version-collision challenge killed by surveying the guard convention across g25 through g28. The subject is unmoved at 14f1c34b... mode 0444. Twenty-two digest checks pass with zero mismatches and no cross-citation conflict. recordedInputs.HEAD, the top-level head and live HEAD are identical, and HEAD is confirmed to be the D-202 adoption commit. The DR-G28 live row reproduces exactly and the harness's liveHarnessCellVerbatim matches the live cell character for character. No D9 class, exit or HostTermination token is enumerated anywhere in the subject. The subject is correctly silent on gates 2 and 3, which D-154 uniquely flipped to holding. The leftoverDesign set is exactly ['OBL-G28-FX-AUTHORING'], unchanged across v1, v2 and v3, the six-member partition is exact, D-154's NT-7/NT-8 closure stands unreopened, required-now stays 28, and nothing is SATISFIED, QUALIFIED, sealed, or authorized.
